name.sw: Bibi na Babu

who.en:
For a person aged 60 and over living at home in Dar es Salaam, and for the family member who cares for them. Tanzania counted about 3.5 million people aged 60 and over in the 2022 census, and WHO expects one person in six worldwide to be over 60 by 2030. Most older Tanzanians are cared for at home by their families, often by a daughter or grandchild who also works.

The box is built on WHO’s view of healthy ageing: keep the person’s own capacity for as long as possible and adapt the home around them. It follows three WHO fact sheets and one WHO guideline: Ageing and health (falls, urinary incontinence and pressure ulcers are the geriatric syndromes that follow loss of independence), Falls (71% of deaths from falls are among people aged 60 and over; exercise that challenges balance and targeted home-hazard reduction work), Oral health (fluoride protects teeth at every age), and the ICOPE guidelines on integrated care for older people (mobility, nutrition, sight, hearing, continence, mood). Blood pressure is in the box because only 17.6% of Tanzanians with high blood pressure know they have it (WHO country profile, 2012).

The box comes at three levels, chosen with the family and changed as needs change: Active (independent), Assisted (needs some help, light incontinence) and Bed-bound (full care in bed). Each level opens with a first box that brings the durable items once; after that only the everyday goods arrive. The Active level arrives once every three months, because a monthly box of a few toiletries cannot pay its own delivery.
who.sw:
Kwa mtu mwenye umri wa miaka 60 na zaidi anayeishi nyumbani Dar es Salaam, na kwa mwanafamilia anayemhudumia. Sensa ya 2022 ilihesabu takriban watu milioni 3.5 wenye umri wa miaka 60 na zaidi nchini Tanzania, na WHO inatarajia mtu mmoja kati ya sita duniani kuwa na zaidi ya miaka 60 ifikapo 2030. Wazee wengi wa Kitanzania huhudumiwa nyumbani na familia zao, mara nyingi na binti au mjukuu ambaye pia anafanya kazi.

Sanduku limejengwa juu ya mtazamo wa WHO wa kuzeeka kwa afya: kulinda uwezo wa mtu mwenyewe kwa muda mrefu iwezekanavyo na kurekebisha nyumba kumzunguka. Linafuata taarifa tatu za WHO na mwongozo mmoja wa WHO: Kuzeeka na afya (kuanguka, kushindwa kuzuia mkojo na vidonda vya kulala ni matatizo makuu yanayofuata kupoteza uwezo wa kujitegemea), Kuanguka (71% ya vifo vinavyotokana na kuanguka ni vya watu wenye miaka 60 na zaidi; mazoezi ya mizani na kupunguza hatari nyumbani hufanya kazi), Afya ya kinywa (floraidi hulinda meno katika umri wowote), na miongozo ya ICOPE ya huduma jumuishi kwa wazee (kutembea, lishe, kuona, kusikia, kuzuia mkojo, hali ya moyo). Kipimo cha shinikizo la damu kimo kwa sababu ni 17.6% tu ya Watanzania wenye shinikizo la juu la damu wanaojua hali yao (taarifa ya WHO ya nchi, 2012).

Sanduku lina viwango vitatu, vinavyochaguliwa pamoja na familia na kubadilishwa mahitaji yanapobadilika: Anajitegemea, Anasaidiwa (anahitaji msaada kiasi, kuvuja kidogo kwa mkojo) na Yuko kitandani (huduma kamili kitandani). Kila kiwango huanza na sanduku la kwanza linaloleta vifaa vya kudumu mara moja; baada ya hapo huja bidhaa za kila siku tu. Kiwango cha Anajitegemea huletwa mara moja kila miezi mitatu, kwa sababu sanduku la kila mwezi la vitu vichache vya usafi haliwezi kulipia usafirishaji wake.

clinic_line.en: Your clinic decides your blood-pressure and sugar tests and how often to take them, any medicine and its dose, and whether incontinence, a sore or a fall needs treatment. Afya does not sell medicines: the licensed partner pharmacy supplies them on the clinic’s prescription. A sudden change in alertness, a fall with pain, a fever, or a red or open sore goes to the clinic the same day; do not wait for the next box.
clinic_line.sw: Kliniki yako ndiyo inayoamua vipimo vya shinikizo la damu na sukari na mara ngapi vichukuliwe, dawa yoyote na dozi yake, na kama kushindwa kuzuia mkojo, kidonda au kuanguka kunahitaji tiba. Afya haiuzi dawa: famasia mshirika yenye leseni huzitoa kwa maagizo ya kliniki. Mabadiliko ya ghafla ya fahamu, kuanguka na kuumia, homa, au kidonda chekundu au kilicho wazi hupelekwa kliniki siku hiyo hiyo; usisubiri sanduku lijalo.

name.en: Body lotion for dry, thin skin
name.sw: Losheni ya mwili kwa ngozi kavu na nyembamba

why.en: Older skin makes less oil and becomes thin and dry; dry skin itches, cracks and tears, and is the first step towards skin breakdown and infection. A plain, lightly perfumed lotion applied straight after washing is the base of skin care for older people and for anyone at risk of pressure ulcers (WHO lists pressure ulcers among the geriatric syndromes of older age). Strongly perfumed products are avoided because they sting broken skin.
why.sw: Ngozi ya mtu mzee hutoa mafuta kidogo, huwa nyembamba na kavu; ngozi kavu huwasha, hupasuka na kuchanika, na ndiyo mwanzo wa vidonda na maambukizi. Kupaka losheni isiyo na manukato makali mara baada ya kuoga ndiyo msingi wa kutunza ngozi ya wazee na ya mtu yeyote aliye hatarini kupata vidonda vya kulala (WHO inavitaja vidonda vya kulala miongoni mwa matatizo makuu ya uzeeni). Bidhaa zenye manukato makali haziletwi kwa sababu huuma kwenye ngozi iliyochubuka.

why.en: Gums recede with age and expose the root of the tooth, which is sensitive and decays easily; WHO notes that untreated decay and severe gum disease are among the commonest conditions worldwide and that fluoride protects teeth at every age. A sensitive-teeth fluoride paste, used twice a day, lets the elder keep brushing without pain.
why.sw: Fizi hurudi nyuma kadiri umri unavyoongezeka na kuacha mzizi wa jino wazi, ambao huuma na kuoza kwa urahisi; WHO inaeleza kwamba meno yaliyooza bila kutibiwa na magonjwa makali ya fizi ni miongoni mwa matatizo yaliyoenea zaidi duniani, na kwamba floraidi hulinda meno katika umri wowote. Dawa ya meno yenye floraidi kwa meno yanayouma, ikitumika mara mbili kwa siku, humwezesha mzee kuendelea kupiga mswaki bila maumivu.

name.en: Adult incontinence briefs or pull-up pants
name.sw: Nepi za watu wazima au nepi za kuvaa kama chupi

why.en: WHO lists urinary incontinence among the geriatric syndromes; it is common, embarrassing and a main reason elders stop going out. Absorbent products are a way of coping while the cause is checked at the clinic. Each brief is changed as soon as it is wet, because urine left on the skin breaks it down within hours (incontinence-associated dermatitis). Size is chosen by waist or hip measurement at the first delivery.
why.sw: WHO inataja kushindwa kuzuia mkojo kuwa miongoni mwa matatizo makuu ya uzeeni; ni hali ya kawaida, ya aibu na ni sababu kuu ya wazee kuacha kutoka nje. Nepi ni njia ya kukabiliana na hali hiyo wakati chanzo chake kinachunguzwa kliniki. Kila nepi hubadilishwa mara inapolowa, kwa sababu mkojo ukibaki kwenye ngozi huiharibu ndani ya saa chache. Saizi huchaguliwa kwa kupima kiuno au nyonga siku ya kwanza ya kuletewa.

name.en: Barrier ointment for skin in contact with urine

why.en: After each change the skin is cleaned gently and a thin barrier layer is applied, so the next wetting does not reach the skin. Petroleum jelly is the plain barrier; zinc creams are offered as paid swaps for skin that is already red. Medicated creams are for a rash a clinician has seen.

Mafuta ya mgando ndiyo kinga ya kawaida; krimu za zinki zinapatikana kwa nyongeza ya bei kwa ngozi iliyokwisha kuwa nyekundu. Krimu zenye dawa ni kwa vipele vilivyoonwa na mtaalamu wa afya.

tiers.en: Regular = the core box with default brands. Premium = core + the premium item. Luxury = core + the luxury item. The luxury item is priced as its own line at shelf price, outside the saving (D4); it ships with each box.
tiers.sw: Kawaida = sanduku la msingi lenye chapa za msingi. Premium = sanduku la msingi + bidhaa ya premium. Anasa = sanduku la msingi + bidhaa ya anasa. Bidhaa ya anasa ina bei yake peke yake kwa bei ya rafu, nje ya punguzo (D4); huja na kila sanduku.

services_note.en: Included at no fee (store services): a blood pressure, sugar and weight check in store each month (or at each 3-monthly visit at the Active level), a short report of the readings sent to family members who live away, a medicines review with the partner pharmacist every 6 months, and a demonstration of the strength-and-balance exercises at the first visit. Add-ons with no partner quote yet (R7), so not in the box price: home physiotherapy, a home nursing visit for bed bathing and skin checks (AfyaDepot’s home “Bed Bath & Hygiene” visit is listed at TSh 40,000 as a market reference), and a pressure-relieving mattress for the Bed-bound level.
services_note.sw: Zimo bila ada (huduma za duka): kupima shinikizo la damu, sukari na uzito dukani kila mwezi (au kila ziara ya miezi 3 kwa kiwango cha Anajitegemea), ripoti fupi ya vipimo kwa wanafamilia wanaoishi mbali, mapitio ya dawa na mfamasia mshirika kila miezi 6, na maonyesho ya mazoezi ya nguvu na mizani katika ziara ya kwanza. Huduma za nyongeza ambazo bado hazina bei ya mshirika (R7), hivyo hazimo kwenye bei ya sanduku: tiba ya viungo nyumbani, ziara ya muuguzi nyumbani kwa kuogesha kitandani na kukagua ngozi (ziara ya AfyaDepot ya “Bed Bath & Hygiene” imeorodheshwa kwa TSh 40,000 kama kielelezo cha soko), na godoro la kupunguza mgandamizo kwa kiwango cha Yuko kitandani.

delivery_note.en: Active level: one box every 3 months, so that each box covers its own packing and delivery (D4). Assisted and Bed-bound: monthly. The family can move between levels at any renewal; the first box of a new level brings only durable items the household does not already have.
delivery_note.sw: Kiwango cha Anajitegemea: sanduku moja kila miezi 3, ili kila sanduku lilipie upakiaji na usafirishaji wake (D4). Anasaidiwa na Yuko kitandani: kila mwezi. Familia inaweza kuhamia kiwango kingine kila inapohuisha; sanduku la kwanza la kiwango kipya huleta tu vifaa vya kudumu ambavyo nyumba haina tayari.
